# Cub Scouts {-}

## What is it? {-}
:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="25%"}
![](../include/img/CubScoutsLogo-FullColor-CSBC.jpg){fig-align="left" width=60%}
:::

::: {.column width="75%"}
[Cub Scouts](https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-scouts/) is a youth program for boys and girls in kindergarten through fifth grade (ages 5 to 10) focused on character development, citizenship, leadership, and outdoor fun.

The Cub Scout program is run by volunteers to guide youth safely, plan activities, and deliver the program. There are many different volunteer positions, which require different training to make it easier to be effective in your chosen position.
:::

::::

View [training requirements (external link)](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Position-Trained-Requirements-Oct2025.pdf) for all positions.
